description: This file is a C header (.h) file defining the interface for the Beep Module Container Object, including function prototypes for creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions related to the module container.

methods.name: BeepCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates a new Beep Module Container object, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BeepMcoCreate
methods.description: Constructs a new instance of the Beep Module Container object, initializing it with given contexts.

methods.name: BeepMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the Beep Module Container object.

methods.name: BeepMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects necessary for the Beep Module container.

methods.name: BeepMcoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the Beep Module Container object.
